validation.validation_scope: Exact parsed source spans/full rows, claim links, source identity, and company-disjoint splits; not semantic answer accuracy or exhaustive relevance.
validation.coverage_counting: Year/company counts include each distinct source year/company once per question; comparative questions can contribute to several companies.
validation.memory_policy: Stream each source document; retain only gold-selected element/table fields, then release them.

query_manifest.inputs: question text only; no gold documents, evidence, answers, or filters

scope: all indexed reports, no gold company/year filters or query decomposition

tuning.normalization: per-query candidate-list min-max; negate SQLite BM25; constant list=1; missing=0
tuning.tie_breaker: closest to 0.5, then smaller alpha (absolute tolerance 1e-12)

metric_definitions.document_recall: fraction of distinct gold report IDs among the first k chunks, macro per question
metric_definitions.evidence_recall: fraction of canonical required source spans/rows fully covered by the first k chunks, macro per question
metric_definitions.all_evidence_hit: fraction of questions with every required evidence unit recovered
metric_definitions.context_tokens: sum of existing cl100k_base token_count for the first k chunks, including overlap

limitations: Agent-authored, source-checked labels await independent human semantic review.
Small company-disjoint question split; companies share templates and remain in the searchable corpus.
Gold passages are non-exhaustive; valid unjudged passages receive no evidence credit.
Summary coverage measures selected claims, not answer completeness or generated-answer quality.
A fixed chunk count does not equal a fixed context-token budget; context length is reported.
No test-label tuning; model/chunking were chosen in earlier exploratory work, not on a pristine unseen corpus.
